newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Monday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Monday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Monday:

Spokesman Nikolaus van der Pas said Romanian President Emil Constantinescu's visit to the Commission had been delayed due to bad weather conditions in Geneva. He said Constantinescu and Commission President Jacques Santer's meeting in the Breydel's VIP Corner would therefore be postponed to later in the afternoon. Further developments will be available in his office, he said.

Spokesman Peter Guilford briefed on the Information Technology Agreement (ITA). He said negotiations had taken place until late Friday on additional products to be concerned by the agreement and on additional delays for Thailand, Indonesia, South Korea and Costa Rica. Guilford said the goal remained to ensure including 90 percent of the information technolgy trade in the agreement by April 1997.

In answer to a question, Guilford said the Commission would ask World Trade Organisation (WTO) Director General Renato Ruggiero to intervene himself to chose the members of a WTO dispute panel over the Helms-Burton law on investment in Cuba because the Commission's attempt to agree them with U.S. had not succeeded.

In answer to a question, spokesman Josep Coll i Carbo said a meeting between Palestinian President Yasser Arafat and the Dutch Presidency was probably a bilateral one since the Commission would otherwise have to be involved.
Asked about labelling in the case of genetically modified organisms, spokesman Peter Jorgensen said that member states could apply for food labelling regulation before time.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/79: The Commission launches the 1997 Leonardo da Vinci programme (Brussels, 3-6 February 1997).
- IP/97/81: Financial services: Germany referred to Court over investment trust restrictions.
- Speech/97/27: Speech by Commissioner Franz Fischler on "Agricultural reform in the new Europe".
- Speech/97/28: Speech by Commissioner Christos Papoutsis at forum on the transfer of businesses.
- Eurostat news release No 9/97: EU inflation stays at record low.
- Eurostat news release No 10/97: Eurostat rules on accounting issues.
- Eurostat - Economy and finance No 1-1997: ECU-EMS information & Central Bank interest rates.
